verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Mailgun webhooks that push real-time event data to your application (mailgun-docs-8), but nothing in the pack describes signed webhook payloads or signature verification code. DKIM/SPF/DMARC anti-spoofing is email-sender authentication, an adjacent feature that does not verify webhook authenticity. Webhook signing is a fair question for an email API with webhooks, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify webhook authenticity — signed payloads with documented signature verification code — so spoofed events can't poison my delivery state
